title: Domain Registrations Price Schedule by TLD
content:
# Domain Registrations — Price Schedule by TLD

All prices of Domain Registrations are quoted in USD per registration year. The registration, renewal and transfer prices exclude the ICANN fee, which is passed through separately on the TLDs whose registry is ICANN-contracted and is shown as USD 0.00 where it does not apply. Every computed domain amount is rounded half up to the cent.

| TLD product | First-year registration | Renewal year (and each additional year of a multi-year registration) | Inbound transfer (includes the one-year extension) | Redemption restore fee | ICANN fee per year | Registry lock, per year | WHOIS privacy, per year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| .us Domain Registration | USD 8.98 | USD 11.98 | USD 11.98 | USD 89.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 |
| .ca Domain Registration | USD 12.98 | USD 15.98 | USD 13.98 | USD 49.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 |
| .com Domain Registration | USD 12.98 | USD 17.98 | USD 14.98 | USD 89.00 | USD 0.20 | USD 99.00 | USD 0.00 |
| .org Domain Registration | USD 11.98 | USD 18.98 | USD 14.98 | USD 89.00 | USD 0.20 | USD 99.00 | USD 0.00 |
| .net Domain Registration | USD 13.98 | USD 19.98 | USD 16.98 | USD 89.00 | USD 0.20 | USD 99.00 | USD 0.00 |
| .co Domain Registration | USD 29.98 | USD 32.98 | USD 28.98 | USD 129.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 99.00 | USD 0.00 |
| .io Domain Registration | USD 49.98 | USD 56.98 | USD 52.98 | USD 159.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 |

## Notes on the columns

- **First-year registration** is the price of the first year of a new registration. Each further year of the same registration order is priced at the renewal-year column.
- **Redemption restore fee** is charged in addition to the renewal year that a restore always includes.
- **ICANN fee per year** is passed through on purchases, renewals, transfers and restores for each registration year; USD 0.00 means the TLD is not ICANN-contracted.
- **Registry lock** shows USD 0.00 where the registry-level lock service is not available for the TLD.
- **Rounding**: every computed domain amount is rounded half up to the cent, so a figure ending in exactly half a cent is rounded to the higher cent.

## Reading the schedule

Q: Is the ICANN fee part of the renewal-year price shown above?
A: No. The renewal-year column excludes it; on .com, .org and .net Domain Registrations the ICANN fee of USD 0.20 is a separate per-year figure, and on .us, .ca, .co and .io it is USD 0.00.

Q: Which TLD carries the lowest restore fee?
A: The .ca Domain Registration, at USD 49.00; .co and .io carry USD 129.00 and USD 159.00, and the remaining TLDs USD 89.00.
